findings.description: Procedural synthetic fixtures generated by scripts/prepare_benchmark_data.py were placed in data/processed/mvtec and data/processed/visa, obscuring synthetic vs real provenance.
findings.remediation: Segregate into data/synthetic_fixtures/ and data/real/ with SHA-256 manifests.

findings.description: VISTA-VLM v4 reported in-domain pixel AUROC of ~0.5385 and AUPRO of ~0.2123 due to unguided 14x upsampling and ungrounded neural decoder.
findings.remediation: Integrate empirical nominal patch memory residual guidance and boundary-aware refinement.

findings.description: In Track 1, only bottle was evaluated in-domain for VISTA. VISTA was absent from Track 4 few-shot evaluation.
findings.remediation: Expand evaluation across all available categories and include VISTA in Track 4 few-shot benchmarks.

findings.description: Conformal and OOD modules fallback to heuristic p-values (1 - score) and default thresholds (0.5) when uncalibrated.
findings.remediation: Enforce UNCALIBRATED state requiring human review; prohibit autonomous pass.

findings.description: POST /inspect/batch allowed arbitrary server filesystem path ingestion (Arbitrary File Read / Path Traversal).
findings.remediation: Remove client-supplied filesystem paths from API endpoints; use validated multipart uploads.

findings.description: POST /inspect read complete upload into memory before checking file size (Denial of Service).
findings.remediation: Enforce streaming chunk-size checks and PIL decompression bomb safeguards.

findings.description: Software tests were conflated with functional safety certification; no formal FMEA, hazard analysis, or safety case existed.
findings.remediation: Formulate comprehensive safety case and explicitly declare platform as non-safety-critical advisory tool.
